name: Pikachu
notes: Painted design: a fine fur grain painted into _dif (short strokes, direction visible on the back and head), brown back stripes and tail base, black ear tips; _nor is near-flat noise (the flocky grain).

So: short fur along the painted strokes (structure tensor of the _dif luminance), half painted strokes sharpened along the flow, half new strands at the same length; ears longer and softer within 12 texels of the edge; tail a little shorter and flatter (it reads as a flat plate in the design).
Stripes and ear tips are fur markings: same fur, colours locked. Cheeks (own texture) untouched: upscale only.
Body shader 12075339 (flocky) binds _dif and _nor (BC7) only, no _par: the fur relief and albedo load in game; there is no _par output (it would never be read).
